name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-08-05, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.05 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
